facts.fact: Galaxy Backbone announces its NSSC DC1 Phase 1 in Abuja was awarded Uptime Institute Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility; GBB offers cloud and colocation to public and private sector clients (release undated, page date 2025-01-29 used).
facts.system: National Shared Services Centre Data Center 1 (NSSC DC1) Phase 1, Abuja

facts.fact: The same release refers to Galaxy Backbone's existing Tier-IV data centre holding a Tier-IV Certification of Constructed Facility; the facility is not named and no date is given (page date 2025-01-29 used).
facts.system: Galaxy Backbone existing Tier-IV data centre (unnamed)
